modes.title: Build Your Pizza
modes.skill: follow four cooking steps and match six toppings

modes.title: Sauce Swirl
modes.skill: broad presses and circular sauce spreading

modes.title: Quick Bake
modes.skill: place five toppings and slide the peel to the oven

voice.welcome: Welcome to Cooking Craze! Tap a yummy pizza to start.
voice.again: What pizza shall we make next?
voice.hint-press: Pat the dough with your finger. Pat, pat, pat!
voice.hint-swirl: Swirl the sauce in big circles. Round and round!
voice.hint-oven: Slide the pizza into the warm oven.
voice.build-sauce: Swirl the tomato sauce to every edge.
voice.build-topping: Match each topping to its picture.
voice.build-bake: Slide the pizza into the oven!
voice.build-cheer: Pizza perfect! You made a delicious pizza!
voice.swirl-intro: Let's pat the dough and swirl the sauce!
voice.swirl-press: Pat the dough with your finger.
voice.swirl-sauce: Now swirl the red sauce around.
voice.swirl-cheer: Smooth and saucy! Great chef work!
voice.quick-intro: Quick bake! Add five toppings, then bake.
voice.quick-topping: Tap a topping, then tap a slice.
voice.quick-cheer: Cheesy and bubbly! You baked it!
